Number:
Definition of Accounting Estimates
– Amendments to IAS 8
Executive summary:
The amendment to IAS 8 Accounting
Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates
and Errors clarifies how companies should
distinguish changes in accounting policies
from changes in accounting estimates.
The distinction is important, because
changes in accounting estimates are
applied prospectively to future transactions
and other future events, but changes in
accounting policies are generally applied
retrospectively to past transactions and
other past events as well as the current
period.
